messages:
alex: Proposal: add a "cohort shadow" preview mode for runtime config changes. Instead of splitting traffic by pct globally, shadow a small cohort of user IDs (consistent hashing) and compare outputs + cost.
trina: sounds good. cohort = stable hash bucket, right? so we can target high-volume tenants or synthetic users.
lee: yes. stable buckets let us replay same traffic later. Two important pieces: (1) per-tenant safety caps, (2) budget-aware exposure so cheap tenants don't get hammered.
alex: implementation sketch: create a snapshot and a cohort manifest: `cohort:{name: "beta-ops", buckets: [42,43,44], duration: 1h, sampling: 100%}` router will duplicate requests for buckets -> live + snapshot (shadow path) but only return live response.
ops-bot: preflight: snapshot schema validated; cohort buckets non-empty; safety caps present.
noah: telemetry plan: compute per-prompt divergence score, latency delta, token cost delta. surface aggregated signal called "safety_score" (0-100). set default threshold 70 -> otherwise flag.
ira: for cost delta we should estimate using historical tokenization of requests, not live charging. use offline estimator to avoid billing surprises.
lee: agree. also add a "blast_mult" limiter: if snapshot increases avg tokens by > X% across cohort, cap request volume for that snapshot to reduce blast radius.
trina: UX: console panel should show cohort membership, live vs shadow QPS, safety_score trend, and a green/orange/red badge. allow manual promote -> phased rollout if safety_score stable.
alex: API: debug header `X-RI-Cohort: beta-ops` to force membership, and `X-RI-Debug-Mode: shadow-only` to fetch snapshot response in dev.
noah: replay tooling: capture a concise event log for each shadowed request: route, prompt_hash, live_tokens, shadow_tokens, divergence. provide a replay CLI: `rictl replay snapshot --cohort beta-ops --since 1h` that replays traffic against different snapshot variants.
ira: automation: after 1h of shadowing, run automatic checks: safety_score >= 80, cost_delta < 3% and 95p latency<+50ms => mark snapshot as "ok_for_traffic". Then we can auto-progress to weighted rollout.
lee: weighted rollout plan suggestion: 0.1% (system warm) -> 1% -> cohort-based regional -> 10% -> 100%; each stage uses realtime checks.
trina: need to define "per-tenant cap" precisely: e.g., any tenant whose projected daily spend increase > $50 or > 10% of their budget should be excluded from snapshot exposure unless explicitly opted-in.
alex: audit rules: snapshots are immutable. only the activation manifest (cohort, duration) can be updated. store applied_by + change_reason.
ops-bot: reminder: admin scope required to create or promote snapshots.
noah: logging: router should emit `intended_target` and `shadow_outcome` fields so replayers can verify deterministic behavior.
ira: edge case: what if snapshot depends on new quantization or model variant? shadow path needs to replicate model environment or mark as "non-reproducible" and do closed-loop eval instead.
lee: closed-loop eval addition: run N prompt checks through the snapshot periodically; correlate with shadow divergences to reduce sample load.
trina: can we reuse existing eval infra? probably, but need a small scheduled job per-snapshot.
alex: rollout guard: auto-hold if safety_score drops > 10 points in a 10m window OR if cohort error rate > 0.5% absolute. manual override only with 2 admins.
noah: added: cost_surge_detector -> if predicted 24h cost delta > 2x expected, trigger immediate pause.
ira: draft console copy: "Preview cohort lets you validate behavior on a stable user subset without impacting live responses. Shadow responses are recorded for analysis; live responses served to users."
ops-bot: sync created: eng-platform -> Tue 11:00am (invite sent).
alex: I'll prototype router shadow path and replay CLI. trina: mock console widgets. lee: coordinate guardrail thresholds. noah: telemetry graphs. ira: wording + runbook.
trina: thanks everyone. links to mocks / PRs in thread when ready :rocket:
ops-bot: checklist: prototype PR referenced, telemetry dashboard placeholder created.
